entries.name: GS-4571 oral tablets
entries.stage: Recruiting oral Phase 1; no posted results
entries.summary: Gilead's sponsor-submitted record describes recruiting Phase 1 research of oral GS-4571. The study uses single and multiple ascending doses across healthy participants, adults with obesity without diabetes and adults with type 2 diabetes who do not have obesity. It has an actual 28 August 2024 start, 134 estimated participants and estimated February 2027 completion.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed trial record does not establish UK marketing authorisation for GS-4571.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by this early research record.
entries.supply: A recruiting US Phase 1 trial does not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: No results are posted. The primary questions concern pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability; planned oral dosing, food-effect and omeprazole cohorts are not efficacy findings or an approved regimen. Estimated enrolment and completion are not completed events, and the record does not establish weight loss, comparative benefit, UK authorisation, NHS access, supply or clinical approval.

entries.name: Tirzepatide in menopausal vasomotor-symptom research
entries.stage: Recruiting Phase 4 pilot in post-menopausal women with obesity
entries.summary: Mayo Clinic's investigator-submitted record describes a 24-week placebo-controlled pilot of tirzepatide in 40 estimated post-menopausal women with obesity. The study has an actual 8 April 2026 start and measures vasomotor-symptom frequency and severity alongside exploratory biological-age markers.
entries.ukAuthorisation: Tirzepatide has a separate UK adult weight-management authorisation, but this research record does not establish a UK indication for menopausal vasomotor symptoms or biological ageing.
entries.nhsEngland: The reviewed record does not establish NICE or NHS England access for tirzepatide to treat menopausal symptoms or alter biological-age markers.
entries.supply: A recruiting single-site US study does not establish a new UK treatment route, pharmacy stock or supply for this specialist research question.
entries.limitations: The study is a small single-site pilot with no posted results. Phase 4 labels the study stage; it does not mean that tirzepatide is approved for vasomotor symptoms or biological ageing. Planned symptom and biomarker outcomes do not establish benefit, disease modification, an approved regimen, UK authorisation for this indication, NHS access, supply or clinical approval.

discoveryPass.method: A separate current-date ClinicalTrials.gov pass reviewed obesity and overweight records posted or updated on 6 October 2026. Broader dated and undated searches covered medicines, peptides, oral approaches, combinations, muscle preservation, specialist indications, early and late trials and stopped programmes across named and additional developers.
discoveryPass.included: GS-4571 closes an older oral-programme omission. NCT07218445 adds a distinct specialist tirzepatide research question without changing the established UK weight-management medicine card.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: Current main, PR #851, all dated review receipts and the open pull-request list were checked. Neither NCT06562907 nor NCT07218445 was present in live entries, proposals or open review work.
